# Roman Resenchuk

> iOS and macOS developer since 2011 and agentic AI developer. Builds native Swift and SwiftUI apps, and custom AI agent harnesses, autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration and MCP tool integrations. Open for freelance and contract projects, full-time senior roles and technical partnerships.

## Services
- iOS and macOS app development: iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac apps in Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit and AppKit, from concept to App Store release
- AI features in Apple apps: Apple Foundation Models, Vision, Apple Intelligence
- Agentic AI development: custom agent harnesses (rules, skills, subagents, hooks), autonomous long-running agents, multi-agent orchestration
- Tool and MCP integrations: remote MCP servers, OAuth, Cloudflare Workers

## Work
- [CloudShots: Screenshot History](https://www.resrom.com/project?name=cloudshots): iPhone, iPad and Mac screenshot search with on-device text recognition and Apple Intelligence
- [Marcus: Second Brain](https://github.com/romacv/marcus-source-code): open-source remote MCP memory server for Claude, ChatGPT and Perplexity
- [Claude Usage Guard](https://github.com/romacv/claude-usage-guard): stands a long-running Claude Code session down before its rate limit and resumes it automatically
- [Claude Code Plan Usage Statusline](https://github.com/romacv/claude-plan-usage-statusline): status line showing real plan headroom, goals and loops
- [All projects](https://www.resrom.com/projects)
